resources.string: Choose apps that must not receive the Shizuku Binder

Selected packages receive no SDK Binder or attach callback. Saving stops newly blocked apps and their shared-UID peers in all users. Shared-UID apps are blocked together. This does not hide installed packages, permissions or processes from Android system queries. Changes take effect after Save.
Start Shizuku before editing the blacklist.
Blacklist saved. Newly blocked apps have been stopped.
Hide the home screen entry. Does not hide the installed package or running service.
After hiding, open App info → Additional settings in the app (if available), or run: adb shell am start -n %1$s/moe.shizuku.manager.MainActivity . Turn this switch off to restore the icon.
